page_title: MAI 1-3 BAY | Mainz v Bayern Munich 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Sascha Stegemann has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post.
90+4' A pass from Bouna Sarr (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Robin Zentner and the move breaks down.
90+3' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
90+3' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
90+1' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has tested the patience of referee Sascha Stegemann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

89' What a great touch by Brajan Gruda (Mainz)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
88' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) replacing Kingsley Coman.
87' Marc Richter (Mainz) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the left post.
86' Marc Richter (Mainz) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
84' Substitution. Stefan Bell will be replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
83' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Tom Krauss (Mainz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
82' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

81' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
81' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
79' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
77' It will be a substitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) is ready to enter the pitch as Jamal Musiala walks off.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Leroy Sane can be given a rest.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edimilson Fernandes leaves the pitch and Tom Krauss (Mainz) comes on.
76' Bo Svensson decides to make a substitution. Dominik Kohr will be replaced by Marco Richter (Mainz).
76' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
74' A cross into the box from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
74' A substitution has been made. Leon Goretzka goes off and Bouna Sarr (Bayern Munich) comes on.
73' Sven Ulreich displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
72' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
70' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds free space in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. It's a poor effort which goes miles wide of the left post.
69' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
67' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.

67' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
65' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
65' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Stefan Bell (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
64' A cross from the by-line finds Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
63' Today's match ends for Anthony Caci who will be replaced by Maxim Leitsch (Mainz).
63' Bo Svensson has decided to make a change. Aymen Barkok (Mainz) replaces Jae-Sung Lee.
62' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
61' Danny da Costa (Mainz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It's a throw-in for Mainz.
59' 1 - 3 Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
57' Anthony Caci (Mainz) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
55' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.

53' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Robin Zentner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
52' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared away by the defence.

51' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
48' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

47' Stefan Bell (Mainz) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball from the set piece and takes a good first touch to unleash a low shot, but Sven Ulreich makes a nice save.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' It seemed like Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

45+1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayern Munich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Brajan Gruda slips the ball through to Anthony Caci (Mainz), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the top right corner. He makes it 1:2.
42' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
41' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
40' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
39' Robin Zentner displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
38' The ball is cleared after Dominik Kohr (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

36' A short pass finds Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
35' Wow, what an escape. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
35' A pass from Danny da Costa (Mainz) is intercepted by Sven Ulreich and the move breaks down.
34' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) unleashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box which goes a few yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
33' The ball possession at the moment is 37:63.
31' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
29' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
27' Tempers flare after Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
25' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

24' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.

24' What a chance that is! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
23' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement.

22' CHANCE! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
21' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
16' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Sascha Stegemann to decide. The relieved Bayern Munich players can finally celebrate.
16' Celebrations by Bayern Munich are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
16' 0 - 2 Goal! Nice headed pass by Leon Goretzka to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 0:2.

15' Bayern Munich slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

14' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. Sven Ulreich shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Leroy Sane provides Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 0:1.

11' Danny da Costa (Mainz) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
9' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
9' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

8' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
8' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
8' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
5' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
4' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
3' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
